messages.content: You are an SRE assistant summarizing incidents.

Incident INC-2026-0801-BILL charged 2,319 invoices twice between 11:10 and 11:27 UTC. Overcharge amount: $48,620. Root cause: idempotency_key was omitted in retry path after gateway_timeout. Mitigation: paused invoice_worker, refunded duplicate charge_ids, deployed patch billing-api@4.8.2. Owner: Elena Cruz. Follow-up: add unique constraint on payment_attempt.external_id by 2026-08-03. Alert if duplicate_charge_count > 0.
Billing double-charge incident: 2,319 invoices, $48,620 overcharge, missing idempotency_key in retry, patch 4.8.2, Elena owner.
